items.markdown:
To export a single ChatGPT conversation or your entire account history as text, `use one of the following built-in tools or external methods depending on your needs`.

### Method 1: Export a Single Conversation via Share Link

1. Open the conversation in ChatGPT.
2. Click the **Share** button in the top right corner of the chat window.
3. Click **Copy Link**.
4. Paste the link into a free extraction service like [ChatGPT Extractor](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHEIkXXENDWThkuMZEmNht05op_z5-OAU-uXUe8bsdDui1gkrXIn2eTV-DHLU8YjEqC64xFeKbZhdABqD9Uq4JYALgZcE-mJafpNg9moudyph1K) to instantly pull and download the text. *(Note: Be mindful when pasting personal chat data into third-party tools).* [[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF1_qDbJp_xFLsGDzCK4KDVNFbWs2dTvLMZ5HaRIbTLFKbyfDceIDqvSrT0uxcO6VNbdtH6g66amCkMwCgTHmwHJvzqZlsGj8ALMXMqJLMFvQnMNtOfWY7G_4vbgIWaneKb1YabbaETpaxYmUtJtlSF4aE6wrSk-QkZtQft4VryO04DvyO5UowaCSFmeoYrkCchHx13Ek)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHEIkXXENDWThkuMZEmNht05op_z5-OAU-uXUe8bsdDui1gkrXIn2eTV-DHLU8YjEqC64xFeKbZhdABqD9Uq4JYALgZcE-mJafpNg9moudyph1K)

### Method 2: Export All Your ChatGPT History (Official Data Export)

To download a complete archive of every conversation from your OpenAI account:

1. Open [ChatGPT](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESUAHEIkXXkOnVTicgtZyYujkrF6k1zwM4MH1QbzIINXJkaZNwjIC0lQI3a-y4OV16GoXM_w65juNzLy9IB8M9FMV_0gHBlFAZ-xtn8zULLmF4) and log in.
2. Click on your profile icon in the bottom-left corner.
3. Select **Settings**.
4. Click on **Data controls** in the left sidebar.
5. Locate the **Export data** section and click **Export**.
6. Click **Confirm export**.
7. OpenAI will email a download link to your registered email address (valid for 24 hours).
8. Download and unzip the archive. You can view the readable browser version via `chat.html` or parse the `conversations.json` file.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uheWqa_Ug4E)

### Method 3: Use Browser Extensions for Direct Single-Chat Text/PDF Export
If you prefer saving individual threads directly to `.txt` , Markdown (`.md` ), PDF, or Word:

- Install a browser extension such as **ChatGPT Exporter** or **Save ChatGPT** from the Chrome Web Store.
- Open your desired chat thread and click the extension icon or embedded export button in the chat interface to save it directly to your device.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESpQEBxCJF16y_-GczeEZEbfZWJy4O6HFZWX7mOv0c-E3nyV4hj86VWxWuzYuFyqUGX6kfjtDytbPeMaMOhc-QHiG9dLzCxSzFFqlTT5q91KZc99nTPrUE6TKEi_yplZfqnJs-xD-L7cbNzWEtrjvFeTckZRgXx5XSvLfhuDpL8GGUb9C3DdrxpqVXK_lwqxZ9blVXFUT9pDe35bSMCiwzI7KN4XRqoUw)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-3QlJjWqh-I)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF11qlduW6X8zyDW5qxaMieqOA8-T5bhtvbDzSbKBSasCm4u2rWSeqsyrcz9our0nA-gTXAT6SZN7Ur26c9LeS1HM8QYlq3pefnWCvUfjsMs6Z8TAc4lru-ChPiAUO2qHWcQHyu44-MYE5d9euIRYncdN_CbCDzOJxAeStnVUvmsF-JIpN5ZJWn2SjVKbf9F8D2cQ)
